title: Which format for the web?
instruction: You are putting text and pictures on the club’s website. For each one, find the format or encoding that suits it best.
debrief: Compress photos, save sharp text without loss and draw icons as shapes. The right format saves megabytes.

pairs.b: A photo from the camp in the page background
pairs.why: A photo can take compression. The eye does not notice the missing details, and the file is much smaller.

pairs.b: A screenshot with the small text of an error message
pairs.why: Compression would blur the text. PNG leaves nothing out.

pairs.b: A house icon in the menu, sharp on a phone and on a big monitor
pairs.why: SVG is a description of shapes, so it is sharp at any size.

pairs.b: The text of the page with accents and emoji
pairs.why: UTF-8 has a number for every letter in the world and for emoji too.

pairs.b: A gallery of twenty photos that should load fast on a phone
pairs.why: WebP compresses photos even more efficiently than JPG.
